_about: Ryth's short-term rental rating for each Monroe County municipality, shown as the colored map and the table on the investing guide. green = easier, yellow = possible, with limits, red = very difficult. 'why' is the one-line reason shown in the table. Change asOf whenever a rating changes. 'whyEs' is the same reason in Spanish, for the Spanish page (es/guias/); change both together.

Coolbaugh township.why: Allowed in residential zones with a township license and a yearly inspection, for up to 14 guests. Communities such as A Pocono Country Place and Stillwater Lake Estates allow rentals.
Coolbaugh township.whyEs: Permitidos en zonas residenciales con licencia del township y una inspección anual, para hasta 14 huéspedes. Comunidades como A Pocono Country Place y Stillwater Lake Estates permiten alquileres.

Barrett township.why: Allowed with a township permit. The township is reviewing its ordinance, so check for changes before you buy.
Barrett township.whyEs: Permitidos con un permiso del township. El township está revisando su ordenanza, así que confirme si hay cambios antes de comprar.

Middle Smithfield township.why: Allowed with a township permit and occupancy limits. Close to Shawnee Mountain, the Delaware Water Gap and Bushkill Falls.
Middle Smithfield township.whyEs: Permitidos con un permiso del township y límites de ocupación. Cerca de Shawnee Mountain, el Delaware Water Gap y Bushkill Falls.

Tobyhanna township.why: Allowed with a township license, for up to 2 people per bedroom plus 2. The township lifted its cap on licenses in 2025.
Tobyhanna township.whyEs: Permitidos con licencia del township, para hasta 2 personas por habitación más 2. El township quitó en 2025 su tope de licencias.

Tunkhannock township.why: Allowed with a permit and inspection, including in residential communities such as parts of Emerald Lakes and Indian Mountain Lakes.
Tunkhannock township.whyEs: Permitidos con permiso e inspección, incluso en comunidades residenciales como partes de Emerald Lakes e Indian Mountain Lakes.

Eldred township.why: Allowed only in some zoning districts, and only with a conditional use the township approves case by case.
Eldred township.whyEs: Permitidos solo en algunos distritos de zonificación, y solo con un uso condicional que el township aprueba caso por caso.

Jackson township.why: New licenses only in the recreation/commercial, commercial, conservation and village districts, not in residential areas.
Jackson township.whyEs: Licencias nuevas solo en los distritos recreativo/comercial, comercial, de conservación y de village, no en zonas residenciales.

Polk township.why: The revised ordinance keeps rentals out of residential neighborhoods. Confirm any existing license with the township before you buy.
Polk township.whyEs: La ordenanza revisada deja los alquileres fuera de los vecindarios residenciales. Confirme con el township cualquier licencia existente antes de comprar.

Price township.why: No short-term rental ordinance yet, so the rules are unsettled. A zoning approval protects you if limits come later.
Price township.whyEs: Todavía no tiene ordenanza de alquiler a corto plazo, así que las reglas no están definidas. Una aprobación de zonificación le protege si después ponen límites.

Stroud township.why: Allowed only in the C-3 district, with exceptions for the Penn Estates and Blue Mountain Lake communities. Permit and inspection required.
Stroud township.whyEs: Permitidos solo en el distrito C-3, con excepciones para las comunidades Penn Estates y Blue Mountain Lake. Se exigen permiso e inspección.

Chestnuthill township.why: Allowed only on properties in a general commercial zone, with a permit.
Chestnuthill township.whyEs: Permitidos solo en propiedades en zona comercial general, con permiso.

Delaware Water Gap borough.why: Allowed only in a very small section of the borough, with a license.
Delaware Water Gap borough.whyEs: Permitidos solo en una sección muy pequeña del borough, con licencia.

East Stroudsburg borough.why: Licenses are limited to commercial and industrial zones. A home in a residential area needs a variance or conditional use.
East Stroudsburg borough.whyEs: Las licencias se limitan a las zonas comerciales e industriales. Una casa en zona residencial necesita una variación (variance) o un uso condicional.

Hamilton township.why: Not allowed in the township's residential areas. In a commercial zone it needs zoning board approval as a hotel or motel use.
Hamilton township.whyEs: No se permiten en las zonas residenciales del township. En zona comercial necesitan la aprobación de la junta de zonificación como uso de hotel o motel.

Mount Pocono borough.why: Allowed only in the C-1 and C-2 commercial districts. New licenses in the R-2 district ended in 2023.
Mount Pocono borough.whyEs: Permitidos solo en los distritos comerciales C-1 y C-2. Las licencias nuevas en el distrito R-2 terminaron en 2023.

Paradise township.why: Allowed only in the business (resort development) districts, not in residential areas.
Paradise township.whyEs: Permitidos solo en los distritos comerciales (de desarrollo de resorts), no en zonas residenciales.

Pocono township.why: Allowed only in the Commercial and Recreational districts, with an annual license, an inspection and $500,000 in liability insurance.
Pocono township.whyEs: Permitidos solo en los distritos Commercial y Recreational, con licencia anual, una inspección y un seguro de responsabilidad civil de $500,000.

Ross township.why: Allowed only in general commercial and village commercial zones, not in residential areas.
Ross township.whyEs: Permitidos solo en las zonas comerciales generales y comerciales de village, no en zonas residenciales.

Smithfield township.why: Allowed only in the resort district, which is mostly Shawnee Mountain and the former Shawnee Village.
Smithfield township.whyEs: Permitidos solo en el distrito de resort, que es sobre todo Shawnee Mountain y la antigua Shawnee Village.

Stroudsburg borough.why: Not allowed in the residential districts (R-1, R-2 and R-3). Elsewhere a license and a yearly inspection are required.
Stroudsburg borough.whyEs: No se permiten en los distritos residenciales (R-1, R-2 y R-3). En el resto se exigen licencia y una inspección anual.
